text: Adding an optional field to the two-sided knowledge store (orchestrator/knowledge-store.js + agent-image/scripts/knowledge) stays JSONL byte-identical iff appended LAST in KEY_ORDER on BOTH mirrors and only emitted when a non-empty trimmed string; an absent field then serializes exactly as before, so the digest (reads text only) is provably unchanged. Assert with a 'field absent unless supplied round-trips identical' test on both the JS (node --test) and Python (test_knowledge.py) suites.

Route-level display overlay pattern in admin-console/api/api.js: compute read-time-only display fields (e.g. augmentDisplaySummary, sibling of augmentDigestInclusion) in the /api/knowledge/graph route AFTER the pure graph builder, so the pure builder stays entries+skills-only and never depends on LLM/heuristic display logic. Persist only authoritative values (real LLM summaries) via the canonical overlay in runConvergenceCollector/_serializeCanonicalKind, carried forward across convergence only while the entry text is unchanged (text edit -> regenerate).

In process-template bundles, the CI lint guard (process-template-registry.test.js 'render with no error/warning lints') builds the graph ONLY from roles' emits/github/channels/triggers — NOT from the labels[] registry; adding/removing a labels entry is lint-safe as long as the bundle still passes validateProcessTemplate (which only checks labels is an array). The gate-violation lint fires only on an agent's emits of a human:*-PREFIXED label.

Label-schema convention for a 'pause-for-human' signal that an AGENT applies (e.g. human-decision-required in core-sdlc.json): { humanGate: false, brake: true } — brake=pauses the loop (like hold/needs:human), humanGate:false because the agent (not a human) sets it.

Cold-nav-safe deep-link into agent chat: navigate to /chats/<agentId>?session=<correlationId> (a bookmarkable query param, not router state); AgentChat.jsx consumes it via useSearchParams only after the agent list has loaded + agent exists (consumedSessionRef guards re-fire), then strips the param with setSearchParams(replace:true). Reuse the existing railTabRequest {tab,ts} mechanism (thread a sibling sessionSelectRequest {correlationId,ts} down AgentChat->RightRail(selectRequest)->SessionsPanel) rather than inventing a parallel one (PR #645, issue #642 AC4/AC7).

Token usage telemetry (#654): the canonical usage-record schema is a two-sided golden-fixture contract — admin-console/api/usage-summary.fixture.json is asserted by BOTH the JS aggregator (usage-summary.test.js) and the Python emitter build_usage_record (test_agent_entrypoint.py); change both sides in one commit. Records are day-bucketed JSONL at /workspace/usage/usage-<date>.jsonl (single-writer orchestrator, NO retention). total_cost_usd is stored opaque and NEVER surfaced (tokens only).

orchestrator/ and admin-console/api/ have NO package-lock.json, so CI uses `npm install` there (npm ci hard-fails without a lockfile); only admin-console/ has a lockfile and uses `npm ci --include=dev`.

First-run Setup Wizard (SetupWizard.jsx, #671) is 3 infra steps: Model Provider (required) + SSH Key + GitHub Token (optional); the Working Environment and First Agent steps were dropped and first-run no longer creates a standalone agent. GET /api/setup/status returns exactly those 3 steps (pure builder buildSetupStatus in admin-console/api/setup-status.js), isComplete driven solely by the required Model Provider step, and finish/skip routes to /team-setup.
